approved.en: Fighting has resumed in the Kherson region after the longest ceasefire ended, and Russian drones struck a Ukrainian railway station, killing 13. Russian forces are now fitting makeshift armor of nets and rubber tires to shadow-fleet drones and using decoy drones for one-way attacks up to 1,200 km, while both Ukrainian hackers and Russian actors have compromised emergency alert apps to issue fake nuclear warnings. A Russian Su‑57 fighter was destroyed by an engine fire at Akhtubinsk airfield, and Russian troops have used the Oleshky ceasefire to mask movements. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Iran warned it could reopen the Strait of Hormuz within two days if its conditions are met. The UCDP recorded 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024. Hezbollah has responded with artillery fire on Israeli positions and has begun distributing its first cash payments to war victims and displaced families. The United Nations reports 300,000 people displaced in Lebanon due to the fighting. These aid payments and the drone surveillance of civilians are new developments compared with the earlier brief on airstrikes and displacement.

approved.en: Iran announced it would reopen the Strait of Hormuz within two days as part of a U.S. deal, while the United States struck Iran's Qeshm Island, according to reports. Tehran continued negotiations with Qatari mediators and U.S. officials, with President Trump saying a deal could happen and urging faster ceasefire talks. Israeli officials urged new strikes on Iran, and Gulf Arab states expressed concern over the war cloud. The conflict remains active with both sides exchanging threats and limited strikes, and 123 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Iran kunngjorde at de vil gjenåpne Hormuzstredet innen to dager som en del av en avtale med USA, mens USA angrep Irans Qeshm-øy, ifølge rapporter. Teheran fortsatte forhandlingene med qatarske mellommenn og amerikanske tjenestemenn, og president Trump sa at en avtale kunne bli inngått og oppfordret til raskere våpenhvileforhandlinger. Israelske tjenestemenn oppfordret til nye angrep på Iran, og de arabiske gulfstatene uttrykte bekymring over krigsskyggen. Konflikten er fortsatt aktiv med begge sider som utveksler trusler og begrensede angrep, og 123 dødsfall knyttet til kamper fant sted i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

A UN staff member died while in Houthi custody, prompting investigators to probe the incident. The Saudi-led coalition intercepted a missile during ongoing battles in al-Jawf, showing continued air engagements. Iran negotiators left Qatar as a draft proposal to end the war circulated, linking regional diplomacy to the Yemen conflict. The war caused 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Den saudisk-ledede koalisjonen avskjærte en missil under pågående kamper i al-Jawf, noe som viser fortsatte luftengasjementer. Iranske forhandlere forlot Qatar da et utkast til en avtale om å avslutte krigen ble sirkulert, og knytter regional diplomati til Jemen-konflikten. Krigen forårsaket 918 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Violence in northern Ethiopia continues to push the health system toward collapse as WHO warns it is near failure, while renewed drone strikes from Ethiopia target Sudan and an Amhara displacement camp and civilians gathering grain in Tigray. Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed has sent senior ministers to military training in Hurso and Ethiopia is accused of using Assosa Airport as a launch base for RSF drones and supplying arms to the RSF. An RPG fired near a school in Moyale killed 60 Ethiopian Orthodox believers, prompting the Orthodox Church to demand action. The conflict has displaced 1.7 million Ethiopians and affected an additional 173,000 people, according to UNHCR, and there were 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Uganda is withdrawing its peacekeeping troops from Somalia after two decades, with a timeline extending to a 2027 exit, while Ethiopia is also completing its long-term pullout. The United States and an East African nation have begun joint airstrikes against a $100 million-earning al-Qaeda-linked group, and the UAE carried out its first drone strike against al-Shabaab in nearly a year. Puntland mercenaries are fighting alongside Sudanese RSF forces, and Sudan’s army reports northern Somali fighters supporting the RSF. Somali pirates seized an Iranian fishing vessel and rescued seven Pakistani crew members. The conflict caused 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

USA og en østafrikansk nasjon har begynt felles luftangrep mot en al-Qaida-tilknyttet gruppe som tjener 100 millioner dollar, og De forente arabiske emirater gjennomførte sitt første droneram mot al-Shabaab på nesten ett år. Puntland-leiesoldater kjemper sammen med RSF-militsen, og den sudanske hæren rapporterer om nordlige somaliske krigere som støtter RSF. Somaliske pirater tok kontroll over et iransk fiskefartøy og reddet syv pakistanske besetningsmedlemmer. Konflikten forårsaket 2 284 dødsofre i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

Armed groups also shot a tin miner in Barkin Ladi, killed two miners in a pit collapse, and robbed a convoy on the Kaduna-Zaria highway. Bandits ambushed a police convoy in Zamfara and killed five officers on the Sokoto-Gusau highway. The conflict produced 1,486 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Væpnede grupper skjøt også en tinnminer i Barkin Ladi, drepte to gruvearbeidere i en gruvekollaps, og ranet en konvoi på Kaduna-Zaria-veien. The United States has imposed sanctions on Rwanda's defence ministry and its military bank Zigama for supplying the rebels, and is moving to remove Rwanda and South Africa from the AGOA duty-free trade programme. Ebola workers are confronting an outbreak that has exceeded 5,000 deaths, prompting WHO warnings of a continent-wide spread. The conflict caused 1,158 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

USA har innført sanksjoner mot Rwandas forsvarsdepartement og den militære banken Zigama for å ha levert støtte til opprørerne, og er i ferd med å fjerne Rwanda og Sør-Afrika fra AGOA-programmet med tollfri handel. Ebolaarbeidere står overfor et utbrudd som har overskredet 5 000 dødsfall, noe som har fått WHO til å advare om en spredning over hele kontinentet. President Trump boasted about a one-day operation to capture Maduro and warned of possible U.S. action against Cuba while claiming Venezuelan oil revenues far exceed Iran war costs. Opposition leader María Corina Machado returned to Venezuela and called for elections in her first address since returning. Chevron is expanding operations in Venezuela and Exxon is urging caution. The UCDP recorded 2 battle-related deaths in 2007.
approved.nb: Den venezuelanske hæren bombet en ELN-leir i Apure, og drepte minst 19 opprørere, og et droneangrep traff et ELN-drogdepot i nærheten, og forårsaket minst 20 dødsfall. President Trump skrytte av en ett-dagers operasjon for å fange Maduro og advarte om mulig amerikansk handling mot Cuba mens han hevdet at venezuelanske oljeinntekter langt overgår Irans krigskostnader. Opposisjonslederen María Corina Machado kom tilbake til Venezuela og oppfordret til valg i sin første tale siden hun kom tilbake. Chevron utvider virksomheten i Venezuela og Exxon oppfordrer til forsiktighet. UCDP registrerte to dødsfall i kamp i 2007.
